title: Improving `collect`
description:
Some minor notes:

-  I'm seeing this error:
```r
> knitr::opts_chunk$set(
+   collapse = TRUE,
+   comment = "#>"
+ )
> library(tfevents)
> temp <- tempfile()
> set_default_logdir(temp)
> log_event(text = "hello world")
> for (i in 1:10) {
+   log_event(hello = log(i + runif(1)))
+ }
> events <- collect_events(temp)
> events
Error: Corrupt x: no names
```

```r
summaries <- collect_events(temp, type = "summary")
summaries
```

- Is this expected? Are summary objects meant to return themselves when subsetted? 
```r
summaries$summary[[1]][[1]][[1]][[1]][[1]]
```


-  Would it be possible to make `as.list()` return the values as R objects directly?
```
as.list(summaries$summary) # instead of sapply(,value)`
``` 

-  Is there anything else a user would do with a `<tfevents_summary_values>` other than extract the value? Maybe we don't need expose the protobuf structure and `value()` function and can just return R values to the user. E.g., `collect_events()` returns a data frame with a list column, each entry an atomic R vector, maybe with different `class()`'s for the different plugin types like `structure(c(...), class = "tfevents_image", dim = c(128,3,3)`. What do you think?

--- 
```r
con <- events_logdir(temp)
collect_events(con, n = 1, type = "scalar")
```
This is great!

_Originally posted by @t-kalinowski in https://github.com/mlverse/tfevents/issues/27#issuecomment-1374864365_

title: Collect improvements
description:
Improve collection of events, including support for audio, images, text, etc.

1. We shouldn't load all that at once. It would be nice to be able to 'memory-map' everything that are not scalars, and only load things on demand, via a method, for instance.
2. Test with files generated by Python tensorflow too.
3. Try to resolve to the same data displayed in the TensorBoard UI.

title: Add Windows support
description: Basically write configure.win to make sure it also works on Windows.

title: Get rid of the BH dependency
description: We currently depend on `BH` for the CRC implementation. We should be able to find a header only CRC impl that don't add BH deps as it's large and takes a lot of time to build on linux.

title: Vignette explaining different ways of writing images.
We should support writing a batch of images by passing an array with the batch dimension.
Events with more than 1 summary
description:
Currently we only support writing events with a single summary.
Should we allow writing examples with multiple summaries?

title: Refactor log_event
description:
We should validate the inputs and make sure that we can write everything that is in the `...`.
This also would allow users to interactively understand what exactly they are writing.

title: Think about resuming
description:
What happens if session crashes:

1. Should we automatically get the saved `step` and start from here?
2. Warn users that there's already a file there?
3. Don't do anything?
